debug_packet.issue_summary: agent: tracker_lost_logged never resets after tracking recovers

error_signatures: tracker_lost_logged never resets after tracking recovers
symptoms: The 'no pose updates for 30s' warning will not fire for any subsequent dropout in the same agent lifetime after the initial warning.

debug_packet.summary: Examine `agent/src/main.c` as `tracker_lost_logged` is not being reset upon reacquiring tracking after a loss period. Currently, the reset only occurs when `announced` is false (first acquisition). Review the logic to ensure `tracker_lost_logged` is cleared any time a pose is successfully acquired while the system was previously marked as lost.
